root_cause:
CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT in rich/_export_format.py emitted `<!DOCTYPE html>
<head>...</head>
<html>
<body>`: the opening <html> tag came after </head> instead of wrapping <head>, producing invalid HTML from Console.export_html/save_html.
best_solution: In rich/_export_format.py, move the `<html>` line from after `</head>` to directly after `<!DOCTYPE html>` (one line added, one removed). Keep everything else byte-identical: the leading `"""\` line continuation (output must still start with `<!DOCTYPE html>`), and the doubled `{{ }}` braces in both HTML and SVG templates, which are str.format escapes. The pre-commit config change mentioned in the PR body is incidental tooling and not needed. Reasoning from the statement: 'fix the HTML export template' + issue #3021 ('<html> is after <head>, should surround it') means locate the template constant used by export_html and reorder only the tag.
hidden_test_demands:
tests/test_console.py::test_export_html, test_export_html_inline, test_save_html compare the exact full output string, which must begin '<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">' and contain '</head>
<body>' (no <html> after </head>). Existing SVG tests (test_export_svg, test_export_svg_specified_unique_id, test_save_svg) must keep passing, so CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT's `{{`/`}}` escapes must not be touched.
locating_signals: Statement says 'HTML export template' and cites #3021 without its text; grep for '<!DOCTYPE html>' or 'export_html' leads to CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT in rich/_export_format.py. The actual defect (tag order) is only in the linked issue title/body, but it is visible by reading the 12-line template. The pre-commit mention is a distractor.
our_outcome_summary: All four configs FAIL in Kaggle env. v4: never moved <html>; rewrote the pre-commit config (distractor), changed `"""\\n<!DOCTYPE` to `"""<!DOCTYPE` (harmless) and replaced every `{{`/`}}` in CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT with single braces, so SVG export raises KeyError '\n        font-family' (6 failed: 3 HTML asserts + 3 SVG KeyErrors). v6: moved <html> correctly but dropped the `\` continuation so output starts with '\n<!DOCTYPE', also un-escaped SVG braces and bumped pre-commit revs (same 6 failures). v7 and v8: empty patches (65 and 34 calls, no diff), 3 HTML tests fail.
generalizable_lesson: For a template/string-constant fix, make the minimal edit and keep every other byte identical: a trailing `\` after an opening triple quote and doubled `{{ }}` braces in str.format templates are intentional escapes, not cleanup targets; never 'normalize' neighbouring constants. After editing, render the template once (call the export function or `.format(...)`) and diff against the old output to confirm only the intended change. Ignore incidental tooling changes mentioned in a PR description (pre-commit, CI) unless tests could depend on them; if the statement cites an issue number without text, read the code the title names to infer the defect.
